description: This file defines a Swift enum 'StatusActivityBuilder' with a static method 'build' that constructs and returns a 'StatusPill.Activity' based on the application model and various status conditions. It encapsulates logic for determining the current status message and icon to display in the UI, such as background state, gateway status, recording activity, camera HUD status, and voice wake status.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a status activity based on app model, voice wake, camera HUD, and other status indicators.
